messages:
ana: hitting duplicates when clients auto-reconnect after proxy 204 with last-event header. billing noise.
tom: can you paste simple logs?
ana: ```
[proxy] GET /sse resume=rt-22 -> 204 X-Last-Event:E7
[client] reconnect triggered
[backend] on_connect resume=rt-22 -> replay E5..E7
```
liu: router currently treats 204 as terminal and triggers backend replay on reconnect -> dup. two options: make router validate resume token synchronously or mark 204 soft-close and suppress replay.
ana: quick mitigation: server-side dedupe by tracking last_event_id per session for 60s. cheap.
infra-bot: alert: duplicate_rate tenant=t-91 +0.7% at 2026-03-20T22:13Z
tom: config proposal:
```
resume_policy:
  soft_close_on_204_with_last_event: true
  sync_validate: false
  validate_timeout_ms: 50
```
console-team: telemetry gap: no metric distinguishing soft vs final close. propose tags: close_type=(soft|final), resume_validation=(skipped|ok|timeout).
deploy-bot: schedule canary: 2026-03-22T04:00Z 5% us-east with soft_close flag.
liu: if soft-close doesn't reduce duplicates, flip on sync_validate for enterprise tenants behind flag. watch p99_router_ms.
tom: thanks. ana please file runbook steps and add dashboard tile for duplicate_rate and resume_validation_ms.
